description: The image displays three pie charts, each representing a different category of evaluation metrics for the R2I-Bench benchmarking of reasoning-driven text-to-image generation. The first chart, titled "Categorical," shows four segments: "Universal Quantifiers" at 29.07% (light blue), "Negation" at 27.91% (orange), "Limiter" at 27.91% (light pink), and "Existential Quantifiers" at 15.12% (light green). The second chart, "Approximate Number Generation," is divided into three segments: "Approximate Quantities" at 45.03% (beige), "Comparative Relationships" at 36.26% (light blue), and "Absolute Absence" at 18.71% (light purple). The third chart, "Disjunctive & Conjunctive," consists of two segments: "Disjunctive" at 49.51% (light purple) and "Conjunctive" at 50.49% (light pink), with the "Conjunctive" segment visually emphasized by being slightly exploded from the center. All percentages are clearly labeled within their respective slices, and the charts are arranged side-by-side for comparison.
